clauses.quote: the teacher involved shall pay the cost of substitutes for any further use of special sick leave that is granted for family illness.
(The teacher shall be charged the current daily Substitute II rate.)
Up to three (3) days of special use of sick leave will be granted by the principal in the event of a death in the immediate family as defined above.
clauses.subject_text: Up to three (3) days of special use of sick leave

clauses.quote: Teachers are allocated four personal leave days each contract year.
Personal leave can be taken for any reason, at the discretion of the teacher.
Teachers who take no personal leave in a contract year will receive an amount equal to three times the current Substitute II rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take no personal leave in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who take one personal leave day in a contract year will receive an amount equal to two times the current Substitute II rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take one personal leave day in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who take two personal leave days in a contract year will receive an amount equal to the current Substitute II rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take two personal leave days in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who take three personal leave days in a contract year will receive no additional amount.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take three personal leave days in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who use all four personal leave days in a contract year will be charged the current Substitute II rate for the fourth day.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who use all four personal leave days in a contract year

clauses.quote: A minimum of one day notice (24 hours) must be given to the principal before taking personal leave, except in cases of emergency.
clauses.subject_text: A minimum of one day notice (24 hours)

clauses.quote: Personal Leave should not be taken the day before or after a school holiday (weekdays when school is not in session for students) or during the first or last week of school.
Exceptions must have the prior approval of the school principal.
Limitations will be placed by the principal on the number who can take Personal Leave on any given day at that school.
Generally only one or two Personal Leave days per school, per school day can be approved;
clauses.subject_text: Generally only one or two Personal Leave days per school, per school day

clauses.quote: Personal Leave will not be granted in connection with any form of job action or work stoppage.
